name: China Man-Made Fiber Corporation
summary: China Man-Made Fiber Corporation manufactures and sells man-made fibers, cellophane, polyamine fiber, polyester fiber, chemicals, and the raw materials in Taiwan. The company offers petrochemical products, such as mono-ethylene glycol, di-ethylene glycol, tri-ethylene glycol, nonyl-phenol, and ethylene oxide; and fiber products, including polyester spin drawn, polyester partially oriented, and polyester drawn textured yarns; and polyester chips.
